sloka: सबाष्पपूर्णवदनो निःश्वसन् शोककर्शितः ।माम् उवाच महा तेजाः कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम् ॥२-६४-२२॥
transliteration: sabāṣpapūrṇavadano niḥśvasan śokakarśitaḥ ।mām uvāca mahā tejāḥ kṛta anjalim upasthitam ॥2-64-22॥

translations.english: The griefstricken, glorious ascetic with his face filled with tears, heaving deep sighs broke down with grief and spoke to me as I was standing with folded palms.
